title: What an AI task looks like
summary: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a broad area of computing. It includes programs that search for plans or use data to make predictions. Different tasks need different methods.
introduction: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a broad area of computing. It includes programs that search for plans or use data to make predictions. Different tasks need different methods. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain what an ai task looks like
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a broad area of computing. It includes programs that search for plans or use data to make predictions. Different tasks need different methods.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: Most lessons are worked plans you can read without installing anything. Short Python examples need a separate Python 3 environment. This app does not call an AI service or need an account.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of Artificial Intelligence. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.

blocks.code:
Task: help find a library book
Input: a title typed by a learner
Output: matching titles
Check: compare with the real catalogue
blocks.title: What an AI task looks like

blocks.text: This plan names a job and a way to check its result. Calling a program AI does not explain whether it does that job well.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Name the input and output for a route-planning task.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not assume an AI label means a program understands everything.
For more detail later, use this [Artificial Intelligence further reading](https://ai4k12.org/resources/).
